messages.content:
Contract notes:
- endpoint: POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/export
- auth: owner or admin only
- rate limit: 3 exports/hour/user
Payload example: {"workspace_id":"ws_8842","format":"parquet","include_deleted":false,"expires_in_seconds":86400}
Never include secrets.json in export archives.
Export endpoint requires owner/admin, rate limit 3/hour/user, workspace ws_8842, parquet, include_deleted false, expiry 86400, exclude secrets.json.
